subject: Request: Solstice AI logo & short customer quote for case highlight
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Mehta <asha@solstice-ai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Solstice AI logo & short customer quote for case highlight

Hi Asha —

Thanks again for the fantastic demo last week. The product team and I pulled together a short draft case highlight that calls out the latency wins and the integration timeline. We would love permission to do two things for our public marketing:

- Use the Solstice AI company logo (svg) on the published case highlight page and in a one-page PDF asset
- Attribute a very short quote (one sentence) from your Executive Sponsor — we’ve drafted an option below for convenience

Draft quote (please feel free to edit): "Redwood Inference helped us halve inference latency and reduce per-token cost during peak traffic — enabling faster product cycles."

I attached the draft (Redwood_case-draft-solstice-v1.pdf) and included your logo guidelines (Solstice_Logo_Guidelines_v2.pdf) — if you prefer different artwork or a particular lockup, send it over and we’ll use it.

If this is okay, would you confirm:
1) Permission to display the Solstice AI logo as shown in the attachment on the case highlight page and PDF
2) Approval (or edits) to the suggested one-line quote and the speaker (Asha / Jane / other)
3) Any do-not-use restrictions or trademark notices we should include

We can route this through DocuSign if your legal team prefers a formal sign-off. Goal would be to publish the highlight the week of Dec 14.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0198

[attachment: Redwood_case-draft-solstice-v1.pdf (pdf)]
[attachment: Solstice_Logo_Guidelines_v2.pdf (pdf)]

From: Asha Mehta <asha@solstice-ai.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jane Park <jane.park@solstice-ai.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Solstice AI logo & short customer quote for case highlight

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for sending this over and for drafting the quote — it reads well. I’m happy for Redwood to proceed with the logo and the single-sentence quote provided we get a quick legal review and sign-off. I’ve looped in Jane (Legal) for a formal review.

A couple of notes from our side:
- Please use the horizontal logo only (per the attached guidelines) and don’t modify colors
- We prefer the quote to attribute to me (Asha Mehta, VP of Product) — fine if you shorten my title on the public page
- Please include a short attribution line: "Solstice AI is a customer of Redwood Inference" (we can tweak wording)

Jane — can you confirm whether we need a simple executed permission doc (DocuSign) or if an email chain will suffice? If DocuSign, I’ll ask procurement to approve the standard form.

Asha
Asha Mehta
VP, Product | Solstice AI
asha@solstice-ai.com

Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 14:18:00 -0800

Hannah / Karthik —

Looping you in on Asha’s reply. Quick notes from marketing:
- We should honor horizontal-logo-only and request a high-res SVG/PNG (ask Asha for the asset with transparency)
- Keep the quote to 15–20 words max — the drafted sentence is fine but trimming makes it snappier for the page
- Legal: if Solstice asks for DocuSign, we should use our standard Marketing Asset Release (I’ve attached the current template we use and highlighted the IP/licensing clause)

Karthik — can you confirm whether this counts as a customer reference in HubSpot so we tag the case and create a public-facing asset record?

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Marketing | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Request: Solstice AI logo & short customer quote for case highlight

Marissa —

Yes, this is a customer reference. Please create a HubSpot asset record and tag as "case_study:prospect-won"; deal id RDW-8954. I’ve cc’d Aditya for legal redline on the asset release.

Hannah — could you ping Asha for a high-res logo and confirm the preferred attribution text? If their procurement/legal wants DocuSign, we should prioritize the executed form; otherwise, email approval + attached logo guidelines usually suffices for us.

Thanks,
Karthik

Team —

Quick legal check: our Marketing Asset Release v3 should be fine with two small updates for Solstice:
1) Add an explicit limited license clause for the Solstice logo (permission to reproduce for the case highlight and PDF collateral, revocable on 30 days notice)
2) A short warranty/disclaimer around quotes (we’ll include a clause confirming Solstice certifies accuracy of the quoted statement)

If Asha/Jane want DocuSign, please send the Marketing Asset Release (I’ll pre-populate the client name and permissions). I’ll be available early next week to finalize.
